scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 eager SFT of 100 fixed synthetic documents; one native AdamW step, FP32 rank-8 LoRA on three text layers, with ordinary backward and non-reentrant activation checkpointing. An eight-event preserve-RNG-off arm is a deliberate control.

workload.scope: Official text-only pretrained hybrid Qwen3.5, BF16 frozen base, FP32 rank-8 LoRA on early/first full attention/final text MLP down projections. Native Trainer and AdamW.
workload.independent_numeric_reference: FP64 full-vocabulary target scoring and AdamW replay from captured gradients.
workload.settings: Ordinary backward and native non-reentrant activation checkpointing with preserved RNG, with 25% LoRA dropout and zero-dropout comparator. Deliberate no-preserve control is preflight only.
